        out=(ctypes.c_ulonglong*total)(*(0 if t is None else t.data_ptr() for b in banks for t in b[2]))
        inputs=(ctypes.c_ulonglong*bank_count)(*(b[0].data_ptr() for b in banks))
        lib.probe_banks.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_ulonglong)]*3+[ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint),ctypes.c_uint,ctypes.c_uint,ctypes.c_uint,ctypes.c_ulonglong]

        groups=[(str(i),[i]*bank_count) for i in range(len(cases))]
        groups.extend([('mixed5',[0,2]*(bank_count//2)),('mixed_lengths',[i%4 for i in range(bank_count)])])

            result=torch.empty((bank_count,64),dtype=torch.long,device='cuda')

            assert status==0,status
            actual=result.cpu().tolist();mismatches=[]
            for lane,case in enumerate(indices):
                expected=cases[case][1]
                if actual[lane]!=expected:
                    k=next(j for j,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(actual[lane],expected)) if a!=b)
                    mismatches.append({'lane':lane,'case':case,'first_index':k,'actual':actual[lane][k],'expected':expected[k]})
            print(json.dumps({'banks':bank_count,'group':name,'cases':indices,'actual':actual,'pass':not mismatches,'mismatches':mismatches}),flush=True)
        print('GRAPH_BANK_MATRIX_COMPLETE',flush=True)
